findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "bridge" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: build_custom_pipeline_url, search_qa_cases, search_prompts, get_my_saved_tools · Private data: search_mcp_servers, get_mcp_install_config, get_mcp_details, get_my_saved_tools, get_my_stack_health · Public sink: search_prompts · Destructive: build_custom_pipeline_url.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: build_custom_pipeline_url, search_qa_cases, search_prompts, get_my_saved_tools · Private data: search_mcp_servers, get_mcp_install_config, get_mcp_details, get_my_saved_tools, get_my_stack_health · Public sink: search_prompts · Destructive: build_custom_pipeline_url

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
